name: phpmailer
notes: PHPMailer. 2.x/5.x ship class.phpmailer.php with $Version; 6.x ships src/PHPMailer.php with const VERSION. Versions < 6 are unmaintained and use PHP 4/5 idioms that fail on PHP 8. Case-sensitive on purpose so wrappers like class-sendpress-phpmailer.php are not matched.
verified_in: WordPress core 6.8.3 wp-includes/PHPMailer/PHPMailer.php (6.9.3; form check only, core is not a plugin)

name: tcpdf
notes: TCPDF. Version read from the file header comment ('// Version     : 6.11.3'). Case-sensitive: PhpSpreadsheet's Writer/Pdf/Tcpdf.php adapter is not matched.

name: fpdf
notes: FPDF. 1.86 uses class const VERSION; older releases (1.7x/1.8x) use define('FPDF_VERSION', ...); both forms verified. Forks renamed to other file names (e.g. class-woe-fpdf.php) are not detected.

name: mpdf
notes: mPDF. 7.x/8.x: class Mpdf with const VERSION (verified). mPDF 5/6 (mpdf.php with define('mPDF_VERSION')) branch is UNVERIFIED. Requires the parent folder to be named mpdf so PhpSpreadsheet's Writer/Pdf/Mpdf.php adapter is not matched.

name: dompdf
notes: dompdf 0.8+. Presence-only: Dompdf.php holds only the placeholder $version = 'dompdf'; the real version is in the plain-text file dompdf/VERSION, which the engine does not read (it only applies signatures to .php/.inc files). Engine follow-up: read <dir>/../VERSION for this rule. dompdf < 0.8 (dompdf_config.inc.php) is not covered.

name: guzzle
notes: Guzzle 6+ (GuzzleHttp). Guzzle 6 has const VERSION = '6.5.5' (full version); Guzzle 7+ only has MAJOR_VERSION, so only the major number is reported. Does not match Guzzle 3 (separate rule) or psr/http-client's ClientInterface.

name: guzzle3
notes: Legacy Guzzle 3 (guzzle/guzzle, abandoned 2015). Not maintained for PHP 8.

name: twig
notes: Twig 1.38+/2.x/3.x (namespaced src/Environment.php). The lib/Twig/Environment.php file in late 1.x is only a class_alias stub and is deliberately not matched. Twig 1.x < 1.38 (no src/ folder) is a known false negative.

name: simplepie
notes: SimplePie bundled by a plugin (WordPress core ships its own copy in wp-includes, which is not under a plugin root). 1.5 single-file uses define('SIMPLEPIE_VERSION'); 1.8 uses src/SimplePie.php const VERSION. 1.8's library/SimplePie.php shim defines the constant from the class, so it matches the path but not the version.
verified_in: WordPress core 6.8.3 wp-includes/SimplePie/src/SimplePie.php (1.8.0; form check only)

name: phpexcel
notes: PHPExcel: ABANDONED (archived 2019, replaced by PhpSpreadsheet). Uses curly-brace string offsets and other removed syntax; known to fatal on PHP 8. Presence alone is the signal. Composer copies keep the '##VERSION##' placeholder, so the version is often unknown; release tarballs have '@version 1.8.0, 2014-03-02'.

name: phpspreadsheet
notes: PhpSpreadsheet. No version constant exists in its source: presence-only (version_regex is the never-matching pattern (\b\B)). Version would need vendor/composer/installed.json.

name: monolog
notes: Monolog. Only the API (major) number exists in source: 1, 2 or 3. Requires the Monolog/ folder so PhpSpreadsheet's Calculation/Engine/Logger.php is not matched.

name: carbon
notes: nesbot/carbon. No version constant in source: presence-only (version_regex is the never-matching pattern (\b\B)).

name: freemius
notes: Freemius WordPress SDK (licensing/telemetry). Very common; old SDKs have had security fixes, so the version matters.

name: action-scheduler
notes: WooCommerce Action Scheduler. Version read from the ActionScheduler_Versions::register('x.y.z') call, which survives builds that strip the header comment (MailPoet). Only the highest bundled version is loaded at runtime.

name: cmb2
notes: CMB2 (custom meta boxes). Bundled copies live in a cmb2/ or CMB2/ folder. The standalone CMB2 plugin's own init.php is at the plugin root and is intentionally not matched.
verified_in: cmb2@2.13.5 (verified against path 'cmb2/init.php', i.e. the library folder as bundlers ship it)

name: redux-framework
notes: Redux Framework 4.x (redux-core/). See 'reduxcore' for 3.x.

name: reduxcore
notes: Redux Framework 3.x (ReduxCore/). End of life; many themes bundle it. Copies in renamed folders (e.g. virtue theme's themeoptions/framework.php, 3.6.9) are a known false negative because 'framework.php' alone is too generic.

name: titan-framework
notes: Titan Framework (options framework; abandoned). Bundles an old scssphp fork (see scssphp-legacy).

name: tgm-plugin-activation
notes: TGM Plugin Activation (mostly in themes). 2.6.1 has been the last release since 2016.

name: kirki
notes: Kirki Customizer Framework, often bundled in themes under inc/kirki/. Also matches the Kirki plugin's own main file. Case-sensitive on purpose: Kirki 4+ also ships a class file .../compatibility/src/Kirki.php that must not count as a second copy.

name: carbon-fields
notes: htmlburger/carbon-fields. Version from define('Carbon_Fields\VERSION', 'x.y.z') (also matches the namespace-prefixed form).

name: stripe-php
notes: Stripe PHP SDK. Requires .../stripe/lib/Stripe.php or stripe-php/lib/Stripe.php so plugins' own Stripe.php gateway classes are not matched.

name: paypal-rest-sdk
notes: paypal/rest-api-sdk-php (deprecated by PayPal in 2019).

name: google-api-client
notes: google/apiclient. 2.x: const LIBVER = "2.12.6"; 2.19+: private const VERSION with LIBVER = self::VERSION; 1.x: Google/Client.php LIBVER "1.1.4" (very old, PHP 8 risk). Does not match per-service Client.php files.

name: aws-sdk-php
notes: AWS SDK for PHP v3. WARNING: in 3.392.1 the VERSION constant is at byte 72,835, beyond the engine's 64 KB read window, so the version comes back unknown unless the window is raised (see README).
verified_in: amazon-s3-and-cloudfront@3.4.4 (vendor/Aws3/Aws/Sdk.php, 3.392.1 found at byte 72835: path verified, version NOT extractable within 64 KB)

name: htmlpurifier
notes: ezyang/htmlpurifier. The single-file HTMLPurifier.standalone.php build is not covered (UNVERIFIED).

name: phpseclib
notes: phpseclib. No version constant in source: presence-only (version_regex is the never-matching pattern (\b\B)). 1.x/2.x vs 3.x can be told apart by namespace (phpseclib\ vs phpseclib3\) but not by number.

name: parsedown
notes: erusev/parsedown. 1.7.4 emits deprecations on PHP 8.x.

name: mobile-detect
notes: serbanghita/Mobile-Detect 2.x. The 3.x/4.x layout (src/MobileDetect.php) is not covered (UNVERIFIED).

name: getid3
notes: getID3 (WordPress core ships a reduced copy in wp-includes/ID3, which is not under a plugin root).

name: scssphp
notes: scssphp/scssphp 1.x+ (namespaced).

name: scssphp-legacy
notes: leafo/scssphp 0.x single-file build (scss.inc.php with static $VERSION). Abandoned, PHP 8 risk. Modern scssphp also ships a scss.inc.php loader without $VERSION: it matches the path but not the version, so treat a version-less hit as 'scssphp, version unknown' and prefer the 'scssphp' rule.

name: lessphp
notes: leafo/lessphp (abandoned 2014; PHP 8 risk). Copies in folders not named lessphp are a known false negative.

name: less.php
notes: oyejorge/less.php (abandoned) and its maintained fork wikimedia/less.php. The version is less.php's build number, not the less.js compatibility version.
